annotation.title: Strange routing here and near the other voltage regulator

result: Removed wraparound routing from both U30/U31 feedback and output-sense networks. The upper divider resistors and feedforward capacitors rotate 180 degrees in place to permit straight divider ties, a direct feedback branch and short output taps.
changes: Rotated R300, R310, C301 and C311 in place. Values, footprint positions, physical envelopes and electrical pin assignments are preserved.
Replaced 30 front-copper segments with 16. Retained 0.25 mm feedback and 0.30 mm output-sense widths.
Shifted the two existing lower feedback vias by 0.2 mm and shortened their back-copper links. Via count remains 327.
Preserved main power buses, output capacitor banks, other circuits, prior CST compaction, board drawings, schematic and project settings.
Updated canonical placement/routing recipes, circuit positions and the power-audit coverage.
quality_assessment: Every error and warning is identical to the pre-edit audit. Only the trace-optimizer informational summary changes. Existing quality backlog remains; no rules or thresholds were relaxed.
visual_review: Reviewed native copper, pads and package outlines for both regulators before and after. The resulting layouts match, with short pad-centered exits and external right-angle/45-degree bends. Review image omits filled zones for visibility; native DRC uses the filled board.
